tier1.text: Neurites are extensions that carry signals to and from a nerve cell's main part, the cell body. An axon is a neurite that carries signals away from the cell body toward a target cell. One axon can branch many times to pass signals to many target cells.

quotes.quote: The main part of the cell, the part that carries on the general functions, is the cell body. Dendrites are extensions, or processes, of the cytoplasm that carry impulses to the cell body. An extension or process called an axon carries impulses away from the cell body.
quotes.citation: SEER Training Modules: Nervous Tissue. U.S. National Institutes of Health, National Cancer Institute.

quotes.quote: A prolongation or process extending from a nerve cell, e.g. an axon or dendrite.

sentences.text: An axon is a neurite that carries signals away from the cell body toward a target cell.

quotes.quote: axon: single process of the neuron that carries an electrical signal (action potential) away from the cell body toward a target cell
